text:
The dish is a small white bowl, roughly 15 cm across. It holds what looks like oatmeal or porridge topped with sliced strawberries.

The bowl is about 15 cm wide at the rim, and the food occupies perhaps 12 cm of that. I estimate about 150 g of porridge and about 80 g of strawberries, for a total of roughly 230 g.

For energy, cooked oatmeal is about 70 kcal per 100 g, so 150 g gives about 105 kcal. If it was made with milk, it could be closer to 130 kcal. Strawberries are about 32 kcal per 100 g, so 80 g gives about 25 kcal. Any added sugar or honey would add a little more. The total comes to about 150 kcal.
